chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhayyna, from al-Ahwal who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Spirit which was in Adam (peace be upon him) — His words:
'So when I have made him complete and blown into him from My Spirit'
He said: 'This is a created spirit, and the Spirit which was in Isa was also created.'

key_terms.الرُّوح: The Spirit — here referring to the divine breath God blew into Adam (Quran 15:29); the Imam clarifies it is a created being, not an attribute of God's essence
key_terms.قَوْلُهُ: His words — referring to God's words in the Quran (15:29), establishing the Quranic basis for the question
key_terms.مَخْلُوقَة: Created — affirming that the Spirit is a creature of God, not co-eternal or divine in essence

ai.seo_question: Is the Spirit (Ruh) that God breathed into Adam created or divine? What does Imam al-Sadiq say?
ai.summary: Al-Ahwal (Mu'min al-Taq), a renowned Shia theologian, asked Imam al-Sadiq (AS) about the nature of the divine Spirit mentioned in Quran 15:29 — the verse describing God's creation of Adam. The Imam clarifies that this Spirit is a created entity, not something sharing in God's essence. He extends this ruling to the Spirit in Prophet Isa (Jesus), implicitly refuting Christian doctrines of divine incarnation and affirming strict Shia monotheism.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Al Ahowl who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Spirit which was inside Adam<sup>as</sup> as per His<sup>azwj</sup> Words
[15:29] So when I have Made him complete and Blown into him from My Spirit.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is a Created Spirit, and the Spirit which was inside Isa<sup>as</sup>, was (also) a Created being’.
en.sarwar: 1. It is narrated from a number of our people from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ’Udhayna from al-Ahwal who has said the following. “I asked Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the spirit (Ruh) which was in Adam as indicated in the Holy Quran, ‘When it is properly shaped and I have blown My Spirit into it [15:29].’”
Imam abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) replied, “This is a created spirit and the spirit in Jesus is created.”
